reviewer: AI author; all 96 raw outputs read after execution; independent AI review agreed
method: Question-scoped exact-value correctness, separate from citation scope and structural acceptance. No external human calibration. Sentences explicitly giving the unmodified exact route count as value-correct; whole-answer literal equality is additionally reported as a post-execution sensitivity measure because the frozen protocol did not specify whole-string matching. Wrong case, missing slash, timestamp in place of route, wrong-version or missing requested evidence are not repaired.
